roles.name: scout
roles.prompt: Read the README and CLAUDE.md in the workpiece; emit a one-page orientation summary.

roles.name: planner
roles.prompt: Based on the scout's orientation, draft a 3-step plan to land the smallest end-to-end slice.

roles.name: builder
roles.prompt: Implement the planner's slice. Touch as few files as possible; emit a diff summary when done.

roles.name: reviewer
roles.prompt: Review the builder's diff for correctness, security, and adherence to the workspace's coding conventions.
